_about: FORGE-DE (2026-10-03): the German side of lexicon.json, merged at load time by item_bank_de.merge_overlay. Keys are deu / deu_* (the key «de» is French: «de Paris»). Verbs: inf, pres (irregular table) or pres2/pres3 (du/er forms with a vowel change), prt (Präteritum 1s), pp, aux (sein), sep (separable prefix), refl, konj (Konjunktiv II), imp, tail (a fixed end of the middle field, «nach Hause»); a complement may bring its own German verb (deu_verb) and its negated form (deu_neg). Nouns: deu, dg (m/f/n), dpl, dweak, deu_at/deu_to/deu_from.
